state: Can is an unimplemented declarative business-language design. It already has typed capability calls as durable outbox sends, typed associated delivery receipts, authenticated capability events, atomic owner transactions and authorized page polling. We must author complete private chat, company-configured ComfyUI generation and reviewed shared-gallery drafts. Required outcomes are retained partial text, reopening the same run without another generation, independent authorized stop, visible unknown/failed outcomes and reconciliation, immutable branch inputs, current access revocation, token/job/dimension limits, finalized authorized output files and approved collection sharing. Every option must satisfy all of these. Exact replay of every token is not required. Ollama streams NDJSON and terminal usage; the official client abort affects its instance, so independent runs need isolated cancellation; no documented durable token-resume identity is assumed. ComfyUI prompt submission enqueues, generic interrupt is not a safely targeted multiuser command, and installed capability/version must be verified. Provider acceptance is not generation completion. A shared durable adapter must retain same-source request digest, provider correlation, sequence, cancellation evidence and unknown outcomes; HTTP streaming or waitUntil alone is not durable. Current verified events can carry cumulative typed run snapshots; current pages can poll authorized persisted business projections. Revocation must remove browser content and deny files. Required request ceilings are enforceable tokens/jobs/dimensions, not fabricated monetary cost accuracy. Terminal execution evidence must not be inferred from receipt success. Alternative surfaces below all use equivalent durable adapter safeguards; no proposal already has an implementation.

run_interface.instructions: Which authoring surface best balances the complete workflow, recoverability, simple source, shared lifecycle reuse, implementation cost and minimal unproven semantics at this draft stage?

criteria.typed_snapshots: Use standard TextGenerationV1 and ImagesV1 generate/submit, cancel, reconcile and changed typed contracts through existing sends/events. Shared adapters decode/coalesce transport, retain correlation and finalize files. Apps author business runs and monotone snapshot admission plus resource reservation settlement. Existing list/content/form/poll renders current state. This reuses settled primitives but leaves a small repeated app projection handler and no exact token history.
criteria.run_construct: Introduce one first-class durable run declaration/effect and generated run observation/cancel/reconcile UI. It standardizes identity, monotone state, receipts and projection mapping while adapters still own provider transport. Apps supply business authorization/branch/output/budget rules. It could remove repeated lifecycle handlers and improve discoverability, but requires precise new language, authority, replay and JS lowering contracts before these drafts are complete.
criteria.event_log: Standardize a reusable durable ordered generation event log and subscription cursor as the shared interface; each app derives its visible run from that log. Adapters normalize providers and persist events. This provides exact local event replay, strong audit and transport-independent reconnect, but adds retention/cursor/backpressure/authorization work and still cannot reconstruct unobserved provider output after a crash.
